messages:
maria: sketching a per-route KPI drilldown panel for Console — goal: token-level p50/p95/p99 + throughput + error rate with a token-latency waterfall for the top offending slices. posting a quick sketch and a couple telemetry/query ideas. want runtime + console teams to align before I open a PR

aj: nice. do you plan to compute p50/p95/p99 from token-level events or from aggregated request latencies?

maria: token-level. request latencies hide left-behind tokens from kernel switchovers and KV warmups. p99 at token-granularity exposes kernel selection regressions.

tom: how much extra ingest/cost are we expecting? token events are high-volume. any sampling plan?

maria: good call — two-tier sampling: 1) always ingest full token slices for 1% of requests per-route (deterministic reservoir) 2) for routes hitting p99 alerts, ramp to 5% for 30m windows. plus low-overhead rollup metrics for p50/p95 computed via streaming digest (tdigest) on the ingestion pipeline.

olivia: UI idea: top row = per-route cards (p50/p95/p99, qps, err%) ; click into route = time-series + token-waterfall that stacks kernel, kv-cache, decode. allow a kernel filter (cpu/gpu/kernX) so SRE can attribute regressions.

perf-bot: telemetry note: new tag required -> token_latency.events must include: route_id, model_name, kernel_tag, kv_hit_bool, token_index, latency_ms. size estimate ~ 4 bytes/event additional.

aj: can we include a derived field kernel_transition_count? it helps find switchovers mid-request.

maria: yes. recommend runtime emit kernel_transition_count and active_kernels list for the request. runtime already logs kernel switches but not per-token. small schema bump.

tom: sample query for the dashboard (rough SQL-like):
```
SELECT route_id,
  tdigest_percentile(tdigest_agg(latency_ms_digest), 0.5) AS p50,
  tdigest_percentile(tdigest_agg(latency_ms_digest), 0.95) AS p95,
  tdigest_percentile(tdigest_agg(latency_ms_digest), 0.99) AS p99,
  COUNT(*) / 3600.0 AS qps,
  SUM(CASE WHEN error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS err_rate
FROM token_latency_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY route_id
ORDER BY qps DESC
```

olivia: for the token-waterfall drilldown we should surface mean/median per component and also tail stack for p99. maybe show top-5 token indices that drive p99 (like tokens 1,2,3,15,128).

maria: agree. operational asks: 1) runtime emit new fields 2) ingestion pipeline add tdigest rollup + 1% reservoir store of raw token traces 3) console panel that links route -> trace view for sampled traces.

aj: who picks up the telemetry PR? I can own ingestion changes if runtime provides the fields.

maria: thanks — tom, can you add the runtime schema change? small patch to include kernel_tag + kernel_transition_count + kv_hit_bool per token.

tom: yep, will file a draft today. will post a small perf estimate once I run a short local profiler.

maria: nice. next steps: tom runtime PR -> aj ingestion -> olivia console mock -> we'll demo in next sync. :thumbsup:

olivia: mock I/O: panel layout + hover text + link to sampled trace. will post wires by EOD. :raised_hands:

perf-bot: alert prototype: route p99 delta > 25% for 30m -> open incident channel and auto-sample 5% for 20m.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone — I'll start a GH issue to capture requirements and a short rubric for sampling thresholds.

aj: ack

tom: ack

olivia: ack
